newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada July industrial price index falls 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada July industrial price index falls 0.2 pct.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Wednesday issued the following economic indicators for June.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
The agency said the major factors in the month-on-month decline were non-ferrous metal products and newsprint, partly offset by in increase in pulp prices.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 0.1 percent in July.
